name: hlc-local-and-receive
description: Millisecond-unit HLC (spec/hlc.md): a single clock processes a sequence of local-author and receive events with an injected wall clock. Exercises wall-tracking, same-ms ticking, receive jumping strictly past a remote, staying ahead, backward-clock monotonicity, and re-tracking once the wall catches up. last starts at `initial`; each step sets the wall to `wall`, runs `op`, and must yield `expect`.
